title: New 'Street Fighter' movie gets attention for its surprising cast
summary:
A new "Street Fighter" movie, based on the famous fighting video game, arrived in theaters this weekend. Much of the excitement around it has come from its very unusual mix of actors, according to a writer at the entertainment site IndieWire.

The movie comes from the companies Legendary, Capcom and Paramount. Some of its cast choices seem expected for an action film, such as Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji and Jason Momoa. But the cast also includes WWE wrestlers Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes, comedians Andrew Schulz and Eric Andre, country singer Orville Peck, and rapper Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson as a boxer.

The writer said he never expected to care about a new "Street Fighter" movie. He only remembered playing the arcade game a little. But as each surprising name was announced, he grew more curious about how such different performers would work together on screen. He called the finished movie "a mixed bag," but said it is never boring, partly because the cast looks excited to be there.

The movie is set in 1993. The writer asks whether "meme casting," or choosing an unexpected group of famous people that gets fans talking online, could become a new way for Hollywood to sell movies. For years, studios have counted on well-known characters, not star actors, to bring in audiences, but that has not always worked.

The film was expected to earn as much as $70 million around the world in its opening weekend. It cost about $82 million to make. The writer says it is too early to know whether the casting is the main reason, since the game is already well known and the movie received mixed reviews.
why_it_matters: The story shows how movie studios try new ways to attract audiences when famous characters alone no longer guarantee success.

keywords.explanation: A cast is the group of actors who perform in a movie, play or show.
An arcade is a place with coin-operated video games, or a game made for one.
Meme casting means choosing an unexpected mix of famous people so fans talk and joke about it online.
A mixed bag is something that has both good parts and bad parts.
Studios are companies that make and release movies.
Reviews are opinions written by critics about whether a movie, book or show is good.

Movie studios often turn popular games, comics and books into films because fans already know the characters.

A movie's opening weekend earnings are often compared with its budget to judge how well it may do.
